name: io-guard
description: In-process IO Sanitizer and Guard: in-memory output truncation, secret redaction, Rule 875 writing style linter and branch target protection.

maxLines.title: Max Output Lines
maxLines.description: Maximum tool output lines before truncation triggers.

redactSecrets.title: Redact Secrets
redactSecrets.description: Automatically mask API keys, tokens, and credentials in tool outputs.

enforceRule875.title: Enforce Rule 875 Writing Style
enforceRule875.description: Block em-dashes and emojis in outbound commits, PRs, and DevOps comments.

enforceBranchTargets.title: Enforce Branch Target Guard
enforceBranchTargets.description: Block forbidden pushes to protected branches.
